🧭 MWJA Sisters Hike!

Join us for a Sisters Hike as we walk together through Rattray Marsh, talk, breathe, & reconnect with what justice means to us — for Allah, for justice, for each other.

Come solo, come with a friend, and leave with a few more sisters in your circle.

📅 Tuesday, Aug. 25
🕧 6:30 – 8:00 PM
📍 Rattray Marsh Conservation Area
🍎 $5 (Snacks included!)

🔗 Sign up now! bit.ly/mwja-hike (LINK IN BIO!)
location: 1180 Lakeshore Rd W, Mississauga, ON L5H 1A1, Canada
title: Hike 🥾
